## The questions for the next generation {#next-questions}

- Which populations dominate the diffuse flux?
- Where inside a source do the neutrinos originate?
- Which Galactic objects accelerate hadrons to the highest energies?
- What do spectra, flavour and time variability reveal?

::: {.notes}
The closing occupies 56–60 minutes. Connect each question to a measurement
already introduced, rather than adding another list of experiments.
Mention cross sections, Earth propagation and fundamental-physics tests
briefly as complementary opportunities.
:::

## What will make the difference? {#conclusions}

More events. Better reconstruction. Reliable calibration.

Shared sky coverage and rapid multimessenger observations.

::: {.takeaway}
The next step is to understand the accelerators behind the neutrino sky.
:::
